posts.name: bolnerap
posts.cooked:
Chokepoint vs. Unity, Visionary, SS Tachyon in Freedom Tower.  I had previously lost to Chokepoint with the Sentinels, the Adamant Sentinels, and each of Bunker/AZ/Unity (just to be sure!)
 
My unlock happened at the start of Chokepoint's turn, after Mission Control had played Scrap Metal.
 
At the time the unlock occurred, Unity had the following in play:
 
- Every single bot, at full HP
- Modular Workbench
- Construction Pylon
- Scrap Metal
 
On Unity's previous turn, she had just used Modular Workbench to put her final Platform Bot into play to complete the set.
 
I definitely played Supply Crate a couple times.  I do not remember ever playing Volatile Parts.  Unfortunately I'm iPad-only, so I don't have a log to check.
 
The environment had Caspit's Playground, three Entry Points, Mission Control, and Medical Ward in play.
 
I'm so happy you don't have to do Chokepoint with just the three TN characters, that can actually be an irritating match.
